text:
maya: Heads up — after the q4b bring-up of model `q6b_r_v2` we see an accuracy dip on promptset_a. Golden regression +8% hallucination rate on microgolden. Anyone on call for a quick triage?

sam: Oof. Do you have sample ids or a repro eval run? Which quant profile was used?

maya: repro attached below. used `q4b_fused` profile and tokenizer v2. Sample ids: s1234,s1267,s1988. Quick eval cmd:```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q6b_r_v2 --quant q4b_fused --prompts promptset_a.json --gold microgolden_v3.json --out /tmp/q4b_report.json
```

natalie: @maya pausing label queue low-priority buckets. we'll pick up relabel for those sample ids. Are these edgecase hallucinations or label disagreements?

maya: Mixed. ~60% actual model hallucination (fabricated facts), ~40% noisy paraphrase labeling where anchor was too terse. Also saw many near-duplicates that probably amplified the metric shift.

jon: Could be tokenizer changes + quantization compounding. Tokenizer v2 does subtle splitting differences; combined with q4b rounding might nudge logits. Can you run a fast isolation: same tokenizer + float16 vs q4b to see where delta appears?

maya: Good call. I can run float16 vs q4b tonight. If we see float16 close to baseline then it's quant regression.

ricardo: Also propose a minimal ablation: float16 -> int8 -> q4b. If the jump happens from int8->q4b that's our fault in kernel/scale handling. I can run a small bench. snippet:```py
for q in [None, 'int8', 'q4b_fused']:
    metrics = run_eval(model='q6b_r_v2', quant=q, prompts='microgolden_v3.json')
    print(q, metrics['hallucination_rate'])
```

labelops-bot: tag request created: LR-4321 requesting 500 samples for relabel (priority=high). see /labelops/queues/relabel.

natalie: For the relabel plan: let's do 1) dedupe by fingerprint + semantic sim 0.88 2) hand off 500 edgecases to trusted annotators 3) add 100 microgolden probe items to the batch for quality gating. Approvers: 2x eval reviewers + product.

maya: Who owns golden refresh once relabels land? I want to avoid flip-flopping gold too often.

natalie: Standard process: open a PR in goldsets repo with proposed changes, include before/after eval, require 2 reviewers from eng-ml and 1 product signoff. We treat this as a microgolden refresh (not full rebaseline).

sam: I'll volunteer to run a canary rollout on a small traffic slice after the relabel and ablation are done. If canary looks stable we'll promote.

maya: Timeline proposal: dedupe + relabel kickoff today, ablations by EOD, microgolden PR by EOD Wed. Anyone blocked?

jon: Need compute slot for int8 benchmark; I'll allocate a rtx-pool slot.

ricardo: I'll own the q-comparison artifacts and post the difference histograms to the thread.

labelops-bot: relabel batch LR-4321 assigned to annotator cohort trusted_v2.

qa-bot: Regression alert created: INC-2026-114 (linked). triage board updated.

maya: Sweet. Can we also add a small dedupe pass (fingerprint + embedding sim) to the ingest pipeline so we don't re-ingest near-duplicates? I can PR a pipeline tweak.

natalie: Yes please. Add tests that preserve microgolden coverage. We'll coordinate review.

sam: ack, will watch the canary. :thumbsup:

ricardo: quick note — when you run the ablation, capture LM perplexity and token-level KL so we can see whether the error is distributional or concentrated on a few tokens.

maya: noted. I'll paste results here. thanks all. :pray:

natalie: tagging @product for signoff pathway when PR is ready.

sam: thanks everyone — keeping this thread for updates.

(automated): thread pinned to eng-ml for visibility.
